provenance.upstream_ancestry: NOT SHIPPED. Filenames follow the Roboflow export convention '<parent_id>.rf.<32-hex>', giving 1549 parent ids, but no upstream source list, per-image attribution or parent licence record is included in the archive.

licence.note: The AGPL header sits on the crack-seg.yaml configuration file, not necessarily on the images, but no separate data licence is shipped. Combined with untraceable ancestry, redistribution is NOT authorised by this manifest.

user_decision.text: The licence conflict and untraceable ancestry were accepted by scoping this dataset to internal method development only. No redistribution, and it must not be cited as an admitted public source.

storage.approval_note: docs/ML_ROLE.md names no data/ directory, while .gitignore already ignores data/ and final plan section 16 requires raw data outside Git. The user explicitly approved keeping raw datasets under data/ on 2026-10-15.

counts.yaml_comment_discrepancy: The shipped crack-seg.yaml comments state val 112 / test 200, which is swapped relative to both the docs page and the actual archive contents (val 200 / test 112). Actual file counts are authoritative.

image_properties.resize_history: UNKNOWN. The uniform 416x416 size indicates a pre-export resize, so no native pixel scale survives.

labels.format: YOLO instance-segmentation polygons (class_id then normalised x y pairs)
labels.empty_label_policy: kept as a possible valid negative; not deleted

label_geometry_evidence.method: stroke width estimated as 2 * rasterised_area / polygon_perimeter
label_geometry_evidence.conclusion: Well above the ~1 px that a centerline label collapses to, so these are actual-width outlines and may support defect extent. This is the check final plan section 4.3 demands for Crack-Seg.

parent_prefix_grouping.conclusion: The export respected parent boundaries when splitting.

exact_duplicates.location: both files inside the test split (1979.rf.d3ee9d85b659ee844d1c26680f05d419.jpg, 1979.rf.dea5db582b997afc4acb0f68d74c3b84.jpg)
exact_duplicates.conclusion: Within-test duplication only; it does not leak training data into test, but the test split holds 111 unique images rather than 112.

cross_split_near_duplicates.conclusion: No confirmed cross-split near-duplicate leakage. The raw dHash candidates were all coarse-hash false positives, which is why an unconfirmed hash threshold must never be reported as leakage.

permitted_use: Crack-mask pretraining and pipeline/method development for the distress engine.
Non-metric crack presence and relative extent experiments on pixel-space masks.
forbidden_use: Any claim about Indian road performance. It is not Indian data.
Any metric crack width, length or area in mm/cm. The imagery is unscaled.
Use as the known-good reference set, or as an aggregate/chip texture source.
Any redistribution, or use as the single 'at most one crack-mask backup' source in combination with another foreign crack set.
Treating the 112-image test split as 112 independent test items while the duplicate pair remains.
open_items: RESOLVED 2026-10-15: ancestry and licence stay unresolved, and the dataset is therefore restricted to internal method development with no redistribution. Revisit only if Ultralytics supplies an upstream source list and a data licence.
The 416x416 pre-resize means fine cracks narrower than roughly 1 px in the source may already be lost; this cannot be recovered.
Splits must be regrouped by parent id before any training, because the shipped split is honoured here but parent groups must still stay intact under our own resampling.
